title: Sun-kissed
meta_description: Welcome to Sun-kissed! Charming condo perfect retreat for an intimate and memorable vacation. Enjoy property amenities like firepits, grills, a hot tub, and a pool, all set against a backdrop of tall sand dunes and palm trees.
description_expanded:
Steps to the magical waters of Panama City Beach that sparkle like diamonds in the warm Florida sunshine and walking distance to Pier Park, this adorable condo has everything you need for an intimate \& memorable vacation. Stylish updates make this studio both functional and cheery with all the comforts of home. With firepits and grills, a hot tub and pool, tall sand dunes and palm trees, the property amenities are the perfect backdrop for picturesque moments to share.

Right on Front Beach Rd. in the heart of Panama City Beach, Fl. this condo is a short walk to Pier Park with all the action of a large outdoor shopping mall with retail, skywheel, attractions and restaurants. Margaritaville, Dick's Last Resort, Buffalo Wild Wings, ice cream shops, pizza - whatever you are in the mood for, you're likely to find it here! Wal-Mart \& Target, Starbucks and more Pier Park has shopping for days! Across the street you'll find Frank Brown Park where there is an amazing water park for the littles, ball fields and lots of attractions! Situated directly on the beach, you'll be in the sand in no time enjoying the Crystal clear waters of PCB.

Uber or Lyft from the airport and you won't necessarily need a vehicle during this stay since you can walk to shops, restaurants, and attractions right from this condo. Easily drive-able to St. Andrew's state park or the East end or 30-A, you'll find this centrally located condo easy to navigate from.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure views, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: St. Andrews State Park, Camp Helen State Park, Ms. Newby's and Runaway Island (karaoke), Jimmy Buffett's Margaritaville, Pier Park, Gulf World Marine Park, Water Planet, Little Village Waterfront Shopping Market, SkyWheel, Shipwreck Island Waterpark.

Home Truths:
- Please be sure to read and follow all house rules.
- This unit is located on the second floor. Please note that there is no elevator---access is via two small sets of stairs.

Parking Details:
- Please make sure you park in the designated property parking locations only. If your home offers street parking please make sure you read all posted signage.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
